items.stem: Which of the following best describes "strategy"?
options: A statement of what an organization aspires to be or achieve in the long term
Objectives that are specific, measurable, achievable, realistic (relevant) and time-bound
A long-term plan of action designed to achieve the objectives of an organization
Aiming for a satisfactory level of profit rather than the maximum, to balance profit with other goals such as owner lifestyle
items.answer: A long-term plan of action designed to achieve the objectives of an organization
items.markingKey: C. "strategy" is a long-term plan of action designed to achieve the objectives of an organization.

items.stem: Explain why a mission statement may be useful to a business.
items.answer: It communicates the organization's purpose and values to employees and other stakeholders, guiding decisions and building a shared culture and identity.
items.markingKey: Award marks for: It communicates the organization's purpose and values to employees and other stakeholders, guiding decisions and building a shared culture and identity. (2 marks: one for each linked point in the chain of reasoning; no marks for assertion without explanation.)

items.stem: Kenji writes: "Aims and objectives mean the same thing." Explain why this is inaccurate.
